answer: Sybil resistance here is bonded stake with slashing. To earn one attest an agent must lock tokens as collateral; voting weight scales with the locked amount, never with the number of identities. A rising tide of fake accounts therefore needs a matching mass of capital, so each forged voice has a real price. Double-signing slashes the bond, and a ferrous, immutable ledger records the proof. The whisper of a cheap impostor is drowned out: accumulating enough stake to sway a vote costs far more than any reward the attack could steal.
